faq.q: What study modes does it offer?
faq.a: Six, driven by the same filtered word set: Word Bank (browse with meanings, synonyms, antonyms, examples), Flashcards (flip and mark Knew It / Didn't Know), Quiz (MCQ in Meaning→Word or Word→Meaning mode), Match (pair words to meanings), Spell (type the word from its meaning and a blanked example sentence), plus My Words for custom entries. A 🔊 button pronounces words via browser speech synthesis.

faq.q: How does the spaced repetition work?
faq.a: Each word sits in one of five Leitner boxes with review intervals of 0, 1, 3, 7, and 14 days. Answering correctly (in any mode) promotes a word to the next box and pushes its next review further out; answering wrong demotes it to Box 1 for immediate review. The 'Due Today' stat and the 'Due Today' filter surface words whose review time has arrived.

faq.q: Can I filter the built-in words by exam?
faq.a: Yes. The category filter covers SSC/CGL, Banking/IBPS, UPSC, GRE, Idioms & Phrases, One-Word Substitutions, Antonyms/Synonyms, Confused Pairs, Foreign Phrases, and your custom words. You can further filter by Leitner box, by Favourites (starred), or by Due Today, and search across word, meaning, and example text. Every word carries a Hindi meaning plus an English example sentence.

faq.q: Are my progress and custom words saved, and can I back them up?
faq.a: Everything is stored in your browser: SRS state, favourites, stats (accuracy, streak, words learned), daily goal, and custom words under separate vb_ keys. In the My Words tab you can add words (with meaning, part of speech, example, synonyms, antonyms) and Export/Import them as JSON. Settings also let you change the daily goal and reset progress or custom words.
